topic: the docker-metadata-action skill: generating OCI-compliant Docker image tags and labels automatically from Git metadata (branch, tag, SHA, PR) in GitHub Actions, and the tag-generation discipline the skill teaches

subtopics.scope: When to use and the frontmatter scope: what docker/metadata-action does (generate image tags and OCI labels from Git ref, SHA, PR number, or semver tags) and the boundary of its job (used before docker/build-push-action to avoid hardcoded tags).
seed_queries: docker metadata-action github actions image tags OCI labels
docker metadata-action avoid hardcoded image tags github actions

subtopics.scope: The action reference block: docker/metadata-action@v5, the id: meta requirement, the images input (multiple registries like quay.io and ghcr.io at once), and the tags config block.
seed_queries: docker metadata-action images input multiple registries ghcr quay
docker metadata-action id meta step outputs requirement

subtopics.scope: The tag types reference table: type=ref,event=branch, type=ref,event=pr, type=semver patterns, type=sha (short and format=long), type=schedule, and type=raw,value=latest with its use-sparingly caveat.
seed_queries: docker metadata-action tag types reference semver ref sha schedule raw
docker metadata-action type=semver pattern major minor version tags

subtopics.scope: The five outputs (tags, labels, version, bake-file, json) and how the build-push-action step consumes them via steps.meta.outputs.tags and steps.meta.outputs.labels.
seed_queries: docker metadata-action outputs tags labels version bake-file json
docker build-push-action metadata-action tags labels workflow wiring

subtopics.scope: Auto-generated OCI labels from GitHub repo metadata (org.opencontainers.image.title, url, created, revision, version) plus explicit labels like source, description, licenses.
seed_queries: OCI image labels opencontainers annotations github source revision

subtopics.scope: The yubiOS pattern: type=sha,format=long preferred over :latest for supply chain compliance per yubiOS.rego digest pinning, plus the containers.bootc=1 label for bootc images.
seed_queries: docker metadata-action sha format=long digest pinning supply chain
containers.bootc=1 label bootc OCI image quay.io

subtopics.scope: The bake-file output and its integration with docker/bake-action for multi-target builds.
seed_queries: docker metadata-action bake-file output docker bake-action
docker bake-action metadata-action github actions multi-target

subtopics.scope: Internal record: the curve-guided-rsi primitive coverage notes on this skill (attestation, continuous/adaptive, least privilege, self-describing, segmentation closure) and how OCI tags/labels place the image in those primitives.
Internal record: the skill's changelog and cycle 5-7 RSI audit trail, its Examples and Guidelines sections, and the boundary-case routing rule.
